content.title: How to Watch Suns vs. Timberwolves for Free: NBA Streaming, Tipoff Time, Betting Odds
content.text: The Phoenix Suns face off against the Minnesota Timberwolves during Tuesday’s slate of NBA games.Mar 17, 2026 7:00 PM EDTMinnesota Timberwolves guard Anthony Edwards (5) dribbles the ball around Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker (1) in the second half during game one of the first round for the 2024 NBA playoffs at Target Center. © Jesse Johnson-USA TODAY Sports In This Story Devin Booker and the Phoenix Suns will hit the road on Tuesday for a matchup against Anthony Edwards and the Minnesota Timberwolves. The Suns come into the game with a 39-29 record, placing them second in the Pacific Division and seventh place in the Western Conference. Phoenix lost its most recent game 120-112 to Jaylen Brown and the Boston Celtics on Sunday. The Suns are led by the five-time All-Star Booker, who leads the team in scoring at 25.7 points per game. The two-time All-NBA guard also leads the team in assists per game at 6.0.Watch More The Timberwolves enter the matchup losing four of their last five games, the latest of which was a 116-103 loss at the hands of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder. Minnesota is sitting at 41-27, good enough for second in the Northwest Division and sixth in the Western Conference. The Wolves are led by Edwards, their All-NBA guard, in scoring at 29.5 points per game, with Julius Randle providing 21.1 points per game. Four-time Defensive Player of the Year award winner Rudy Gobert holds down the defensive block for Minnesota, averaging 1.6 blocks per game. Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker (1) defends Minnesota Timberwolves guard Anthony Edwards (5) in the second quarter during game two of the first round for the 2024 NBA playoffs at Target Center. Brad Rempel-USA TODAY Sports Suns vs. Timberwolves Tipoff Time Suns vs. Timberwolves will tip off on Tuesday at 8:00 p.m. ET. The game will be played at the Target Center in Minneapolis, Minnesota. What TV Channel is Suns vs. Timberwolves on? The matchup between the Suns vs. Timberwolves will air on Arizona’s Family 3TV and FanDuel Sports Network North. How to Live Stream Suns vs. Timberwolves for Free Fans can stream Suns vs. Timberwolves for free via Fubo when they sign up for a 7-day free trial. The game can also be streamed with an NBA League Pass membership.
